description: List what people sent through a project's forms, newest first: answers keyed by question key, the contact, the page and campaign tags. Filter to one form with formId and to recent responses with since, then follow next_cursor for older pages. File answers are file names; download files in the Forms app. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

cursor.description: The next_cursor of the previous page

formId.description: Only this form's responses; every form's if left out

limit.description: How many to return, 1 to 100; 50 if left out

projectId.description: The project that owns the forms, from list_projects

since.description: Only responses saved at or after this time

name: replo_form_responses_list
title: List form responses
